1.0.3.en: Fixed: adding cameras stopped after the login screen with an error ("$(...) is null"), both when searching and when typing addresses.

1.0.2.en: Fixed: a camera could lose its picture and live view (no camera button) if Homey couldn't read its settings, for example when the camera user only has Viewer rights or over a slow link between networks. Such cameras get their picture and live view back after this update. A camera user with too few rights is no longer reported as a wrong password.

1.0.1.en: Adding cameras: you can now type your cameras' IP addresses if Homey can't find them, for example when they are on a separate network. The search always finishes within about 30 seconds, and it now tells you why a camera wasn't found instead of showing nothing.

1.0.0.en: First release: live video, motion, AXIS Object Analytics people and vehicle insights (counting, direction, heatmap, visitors, daily summary), door stations, privacy mode, camera health, temperature, power and PoE, and five dashboard widgets.
